name: MIT CSAIL
description: Computer science and AI research spanning machine learning, robotics, systems, theory, human-computer interaction, and computational biology.
statusNote: MIT undergraduates pursue CSAIL research through UROP; explore a research group and contact its listed researchers directly.

name: MIT Jameel Clinic
description: Translational research in clinical AI, trustworthy machine learning, and AI-driven drug discovery.
statusNote: The public contact can route general collaboration and research questions.

name: Laboratory for Information and Decision Systems
description: Research in information and decision sciences, including optimization, control, networks, inference, and machine learning.
statusNote: Browse current research areas and use the public directory to identify a relevant group.

name: MIT Media Lab
description: Interdisciplinary research groups working across human-computer interaction, design, learning, health, cities, creativity, and emerging technology.
statusNote: Open a matching group's page for its current projects and public team contacts.

name: McGovern Institute for Brain Research
description: Brain and cognitive science research using neuroscience, molecular genetics, neuroimaging, and computational modeling.
statusNote: The institute lists undergraduate opportunities through UROP and public contacts for its research teams.

name: Plasma Science and Fusion Center
description: Research in fusion energy, plasma physics, magnets, materials, simulation, data science, and technology commercialization.
statusNote: PSFC publishes undergraduate opportunities and a public contact for questions about its programs.

name: MIT.nano
description: Open-access facilities for nanoscale fabrication, characterization, immersive technology, materials, photonics, and advanced devices.
statusNote: MIT.nano is a shared facility; undergraduates need a research group and appropriate supervision to use its labs.

name: MIT D-Lab UROP
description: Hands-on research and design projects focused on global poverty, inclusive innovation, fieldwork, and sustainable technologies.
statusNote: The page lists current projects and directs students to search “D-Lab” in ELx.

name: EAPS Undergraduate Research
description: Earth, atmospheric, ocean, climate, planetary science, geology, geophysics, and astronomy research opportunities.
statusNote: EAPS points undergraduates to selected UROPs and its education office for guidance.

name: MIT UROP
description: The central MIT program for finding, arranging, funding, and receiving credit for undergraduate research.
statusNote: AY26–27 deadlines and advertised projects are live; the UROP office also helps students approach faculty directly.

name: MIT Experiential Learning Exchange
description: MIT's central opportunity board for UROPs and other experiential learning programs across the Institute.
statusNote: Use ELx to search advertised positions. Many labs also welcome a thoughtful direct inquiry even when no listing is posted.

name: MIT Makersystem
description: A campus-wide directory for more than 40 makerspaces, training, fabrication tools, biomaking, materials, and hands-on prototyping.
statusNote: Access and training requirements vary by space; the directory shows which spaces fit a project.

name: MIT InnovationHQ
description: A home for MIT's entrepreneurship and innovation community, including student venture programs, mentors, and team-building resources.
statusNote: Browse current resident organizations to find programs for ideas, teams, mentors, and early-stage ventures.

name: MIT Handshake
description: MIT's recruiting platform for jobs, internships, employer events, career fairs, and CAPD appointments.
statusNote: Current students, postdocs, and staff can sign in through MIT.

name: 2026–27 MIT Career Fairs
description: The current Institute-wide list of career fairs, including EECS, deep tech, nuclear, BE/ChemE, MechE, climate, and the Fall Career Fair.
statusNote: The 2026 Fall Career Fair is September 25; the page also lists department-specific fairs throughout AY26–27.

name: CAPD Events
description: Current career workshops, employer sessions, networking events, interview preparation, and advising programs.
statusNote: Use the filters to find current employer, networking, fair, and career-development events.
